title: Continual Instruction Tuning for LLM-ased Management of Continuum Resources
abstract: arXiv:2611.10292v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for resource management across the Cloud-Edge continuum. However, embedding LLMs directly inside latency-sensitive control loops places inference latency, execution jitter, and hallucination risks on the critical path. This study argues for a different use of LLMs: a continually instruction-tuned intent compiler that runs once per management intent or declared context change, above a fast, deterministic tactical controller that handles all low-latency runtime actions. We formulate intent compilation as a continual instruction tuning problem, because management intents arrive sequentially and accumulate while infrastructure and workload contexts drift. Unlike recent LLM-based management frameworks, our design scores the model's outputs by execution, so that catastrophic forgetting can be measured in the executed objective of the underlying controller. translated_title: 面向连续体资源的大语言模型管理中的持续指令微调
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.10292v2 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：大语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地探索用于云-边连续体的资源管理。然而，将LLM直接嵌入延迟敏感的控制回路中，会把推理延迟、执行抖动和幻觉风险置于关键路径上。本研究主张对LLM采用一种不同的使用方式：一个经过持续指令微调的意图编译器，它在每个管理意图或声明的上下文变化发生时运行一次，位于一个快速、确定性的战术控制器之上，由该战术控制器处理所有低延迟的运行时操作。我们将意图编译表述为一个持续指令微调问题，因为管理意图是按顺序到达并不断累积的，同时基础设施和工作负载的上下文也在漂移。与近期基于LLM的管理框架不同，我们的设计通过对模型输出进行执行评分，从而能够在底层控制器所执行的目标函数中度量灾难性遗忘。在一个连续体仿真器上……（原文摘要至此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将大语言模型作为持续指令微调的意图编译器（而非嵌入延迟敏感控制回路中），置于快速确定性战术控制器之上，并通过执行评分在控制器实际目标中度量灾难性遗忘，从而实现云-边连续体资源的高效LLM管理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using LLMs as continually instruction-tuned intent compilers—running above fast deterministic tactical controllers rather than inside latency-sensitive control loops—and measures catastrophic forgetting via execution-based scoring, enabling efficient LLM-based management of cloud-edge continuum resources.
